title: PidgeIoT — Open-Source IoT Device Management
excerpt: Open-source IoT device management: provision devices, push config, collect telemetry, update firmware over the air. Rust end to end. Free during early access.
content_html:
TheIoT Platform*

* Life is full of compromises

An open-source, distributed, and efficient IoT platform. Built in Rust, from front to back. Designed with security, privacy, and flexibility in mind.

Your data. Your control.

Get Started FreeView on GitHub

New to IoT? Try it without hardware first →

Built for the Builders

A complete IoT platform built to work for you. No need to start from scratch. We've created a simple API meant to easily integrate with any device, and the tech stack you're already using.

Interoperability

  • No specific firmware

  • No supported device list

  • HTTPS or WebSocket — same ingestion API (CoAP-over-TLS planned)

Security

  • Token refresh cryptographically revokes the old token

  • Per-device Ed25519 keypairs, not JWTs

  • Self-hosted Ory Kratos for dashboard auth

Open Source

  • AGPL-3.0 Licensed

  • Built on Cloudflare Workers, Ory, and Zephyr

  • Open development on GitHub

Per-Device Keys, Not Fleet Secrets

Every device gets its own Ed25519 keypair, minted where its state lives. Only the public key is ever stored — the private key signs one token and is discarded. Compromise one device, and the blast radius is one device.

No Shared Secrets

Verification happens against each device's own public key — there is no fleet-wide credential to leak.

69 Bytes on the Wire

No JWT, no base64 bloat — a binary bearer token: version, expiry, signature.

Refresh Revokes

Minting a new device token overwrites the old public key — no revocation list needed.

Rust, end to end

Built for Constrained, Cellular Hardware

Every byte costs money and battery on a cellular device. PidgeIoT is designed around small, auditable wire formats instead of heavyweight standards — maximum security with minimal data transfer.

69-Byte Tokens

A compact binary bearer token — version, expiry, signature — verified with one Ed25519 check at the edge. No JWT overhead.

CoAP-over-TLS/TCP (planned)

RFC 8323 CoAP for devices too constrained for a full HTTPS stack — still fully encrypted, no bare UDP. Designed in; terminator not yet live.

Dictionary Logging

Structured device logs from our Zephyr library, shipped as dictionary-compressed codes instead of raw strings.

One Durable Object Per Device

Each pigeon owns a small, SQLite-backed Durable Object — the single source of truth for its shadow, ACL, and device credentials — mirrored best-effort into Postgres via Hyperdrive for cross-device queries.

No Telemetry Lock-In

Point a device at your own InfluxDB-line-protocol-compatible endpoint and its telemetry goes straight there instead of the platform's built-in history store — your data, your database.

Content-Addressed Firmware

Firmware images live in R2, addressed by their own SHA-256 and catalogued per flock. Rolling out a version reuses the same shadow model as config — devices resume large downloads with Range requests instead of starting over.

Ready to Build Secure IoT Solutions?

Provision a device, push config, and watch telemetry land — in about ten minutes, no hardware required.

sentences.en: PidgeIoT is designed around small, auditable wire formats instead of heavyweight standards — maximum security with minimal data transfer.
sentences.zh: PidgeIoT 是围绕小型、可审核的线路格式而不是重量级标准而设计的 - 以最少的数据传输实现最大的安全性。

blocks.html_en: 69-Byte Tokens
A compact binary bearer token — version, expiry, signature — verified with one Ed25519 check at the edge. No JWT overhead.

sentences.zh: 一种紧凑的二进制不记名令牌（版本、到期日、签名），通过边缘的 Ed25519 检查进行验证。

RFC 8323 CoAP for devices too constrained for a full HTTPS stack — still fully encrypted, no bare UDP. Designed in; terminator not yet live.

sentences.en: RFC 8323 CoAP for devices too constrained for a full HTTPS stack — still fully encrypted, no bare UDP.
sentences.zh: RFC 8323 CoAP 适用于对于完整 HTTPS 堆栈而言过于受限的设备 — 仍然完全加密，没有裸露的 UDP。

sentences.en: Designed in; terminator not yet live.
sentences.zh: 设计于；终结者还没有上线。

blocks.html_en: One Durable Object Per Device

sentences.zh: 每台设备一个耐用对象

blocks.html_en: Each pigeon owns a small, SQLite-backed Durable Object — the single source of truth for its shadow, ACL, and device credentials — mirrored best-effort into Postgres via Hyperdrive for cross-device queries.

sentences.en: Each pigeon owns a small, SQLite-backed Durable Object — the single source of truth for its shadow, ACL, and device credentials — mirrored best-effort into Postgres via Hyperdrive for cross-device queries.
sentences.zh: 每只鸽子都拥有一个由 SQLite 支持的小型持久对象（其影子、ACL 和设备凭证的单一事实来源），通过 Hyperdrive 尽力镜像到 Postgres 中以进行跨设备查询。

blocks.html_en: No Telemetry Lock-In
Point a device at your own InfluxDB-line-protocol-compatible endpoint and its telemetry goes straight there instead of the platform's built-in history store — your data, your database.
